title: Correct velocity at 1s
description: Essential: Student must calculate and state the correct numerical velocity at t=1s (6 m/s).

title: Correct velocity at 3s
description: Essential: Student must recognize the car stops before 3s and state the velocity at t=3s is 0 m/s.

title: Proper kinematic equation
description: Important: Student applies the correct velocity-time equation (v = v₀ + at) for uniformly accelerated motion.

title: Considers stopping time
description: Important: Student determines or acknowledges the stopping time (2s) to correctly handle the 3s case.

title: Correct sign for acceleration
description: Important: Student uses a negative acceleration value (-6 m/s²) to represent deceleration.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (m/s) with both final numerical answers.

title: Plugging in time after stop
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses v = v₀ + at for t=3s without considering the car has already stopped.

title: Sign error in calculation
description: Pitfall: Student makes an arithmetic sign error when calculating v = 12 + (-6)*t.
